Implemented data pipelines and model-serving components in Python, integrating model outputs into backend APIs. Tuned prompt templates and evaluation metrics to improve suggestion relevance by measurable margins in A/B tests. Deployed inference endpoints on AWS, used Redis for caching model responses, and worked in Agile cycles with product and QA teams. Maintained technical notes and runbooks in Confluence and supported Linux-based deployment workflows.
